corrections.reason: Canonical Ge'ez Gospel text (Matt 8:4 'በከመ አዘዘ ሙሴ', repeated in Col 3 L02); the bold lead-type glyph at the start of the line is 'በ', not 'ዘ'.
The printed glyph has the 6th-order (ሳድስ) top hook of 'ክ' in the Amharic verb 'ዳንክ' ('ስለ ዳንክ').

Both the zoomed image (showing the 2nd-order ካዕብ right-side marker on 'ፉ') and the grammatical parallel that immediately follows ('ስጠተ ልብስ ንፍቀ ታቦት ... ስጡጠ ልብስ ንፉቀ ታቦት ሲል') confirm the Ge'ez passive participle 'ጥፉር' (explaining 'ጠፈረ ቤትየ').
